actual_scope: For all distinct odd primes p<q, classify essential higher phases in p+q-row orthogonal-column matrices as two orthogonal prime blocks; prove that their maximum column count is independent of prime powers.
scope_change_reason: Extend the p=3 source by replacing its special two-Fourier-line argument with an odd-prime product invariant, and derive a full two-block normal form and capacity equality.
bottleneck_link: Rule out higher prime powers as a source of additional exact orthogonal columns for every two-odd-prime p+q-row interface.
stop_rule: Stop at a proved block classification, capacity equality and exact controls; do not assert the unknown squarefree capacities or physical supplier gains.
evidence: PROOF.md states the all-prime block theorem; RESULT.json records cycle, quotient, relative-permutation, normal-form and mutation checks.
